## Frequent collaborators

<!-- Edit freely: add/remove names and links. Selected from frequent co-authors in my CV. -->

- **Helen M. Regan, M. Brooke Rose, Gabriel A. Backus & Alexandra D. Syphard** — climate change, fire, and plant vulnerability in California.
- **Damaris Zurell, Greta Bocedi, Mark C. Urban & the sModelProBio / EcoCode teams** — biodiversity model intercomparisons for science and policy.
- **Bruno R. Ribeiro, Karlo Guidoni-Martins, Geiziane Tessarolo & Rafael Loyola** — biodiversity data cleaning and the *bdc* package.
- **André F. A. Andrade** — *ENMTML*, *flexsdm*, and niche modelling methods.
- **Admir C. de Oliveira Junior** — abundance-based distribution models and the *adm* package.
- **Christopher T. Blum, Marcos B. Carlucci & Pablo M. Hoffmann** — threatened flora and restoration in southern Brazil.
- **Lía Montti, Norman A. Bedrij & colleagues at IBS** — forests, invasions, and conservation planning in Misiones and the Atlantic Forest.
